periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward diagonal orientation relative to the horizontal muzzle axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical ovaloid morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the patch narrows toward its lowest point below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately 50% of the visible lateral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, rounded semi-circular curvature at the top boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Thin, linear, light-colored object protruding horizontally from the oral cavity area.
